description: ERC-20 token safety check for one contract address on Base, Ethereum or BSC: honeypot and buy/sell tax simulation (honeypot.is), liquidity and pair age (DexScreener), and direct on-chain reads (name, symbol, decimals, total supply, owner), combined into risk flags and a four-grade risk_level. Sources are fail-soft and listed in the response; chain defaults to base and also accepts chainId 8453, 1 or 56.
name: token-safety
